assets.title: Portable turn checkpoints kernel (@vyakti/turn-checkpoints)
assets.what: Dependency-free ESM kernel. It binds one operation to a frozen scope, a policy version and an authority snapshot, and binds the source snapshot exactly once. assertCurrent() re-reads authority, sources, authority, sources (A/S/A/S). Any mismatch or reader failure permanently invalidates the turn. Receipts are canonical, ignore key order and respect array order. It rejects accessors, sparse arrays and non-plain objects, has hard size limits, and throws frozen content-free errors. The guarantee is 'checkpointed', not atomic.
assets.taxila_target: relational-os / safety-floor: re-verify session seats and consent before the teacher uses a private memory aloud or releases TTS; also before generative-ui module publish
assets.evidence: kernel 39 groups + actual caller 170; hosted 24/24 at 808ad32f; registry experiment portable-turn-checkpoints completed/pass at offline_contract scope
assets.notes: Private, UNLICENSED, unpublished. It cannot detect a revoke-and-restore between reads, and gives no durable idempotency. A hung reader blocks progress.

assets.title: Group turn guard adapter (createGroupTurnGuard)
assets.what: Adapter over HMG01. Authority is the current SQL group row (read consent, entitled, quorum >= 2, cap, linked_members) plus a complete platform audience witness. The witness recipient list must exactly equal the SQL recipients, with a 64-hex revision. The guard exposes recipients, bindSources and assertAuthority, and maps every failure to group_authority_unavailable.
assets.taxila_target: group-ai: session seat roster + consent rows as the authority; a seat-roster revision as the witness
assets.notes: The adapter owns all SQL and platform checks. The kernel only compares.

assets.title: Attributed source-turn selector (@vyakti/source-turn-selection)
assets.what: Pure synchronous selector over already-authorized attributed turns {sourceId, order, episodeId, speakerId, speakerLabel, recordedAt, text}. It always keeps the latest 20 turns including the current one. lexical_recency mode adds up to 12 older matches by distinct-token overlap (NFKC, lowercase). It emits a self-describing source_turns/v1 packet with interpretation historical_observations and currentStateEstablished:false; temporal order is recorded order, not event time, and subject/reply/revision are null. A 32,768-byte budget applies to the whole serialized turns. Mandatory overflow refuses. rawTexts is returned separately for honesty vocabulary.
assets.taxila_target: memory-graph: per-child long-horizon recall packets with exact speaker attribution in sibling/group sessions
assets.evidence: selector 46 groups; frozen 48-case comparison (lexical 27/54 vs recency 0/54 older targets; 0/27 in the adversarial half; 288 distractors)
assets.notes: Lexical mode is NOT promoted. Taxila needs semantic retrieval but should keep the packet, attribution and budget discipline.

assets.title: Known-consent source admission fence
assets.what: A source is persisted only if its authenticated original send time is strictly later than group read consent AND every current recipient's linked_at. Arrival and edit time are never used, and equality is refused. The check runs in JS and is repeated inside the episode and log INSERT...SELECT. The PostgreSQL timestamp parser is microsecond-exact and accepts Z, +00, +0000 and +00:00.
assets.taxila_target: auth/consent (DPDP): never persist child audio/text captured before verifiable parental consent or before a peer/sibling seat's consent
assets.evidence: ingress 26; SQL50 including case 31 with the real PostgreSQL wire format; registry known-consent-source-admission completed/pass 2026-10-01
assets.notes: It does not reconstruct historical audience, deduplicate or serialize erasure.

assets.title: Telegram current-audience witness
assets.what: Calls getMe, getChatMemberCount before/after, getChatMember per linked member (bot must be admin) and getChat before/after. Admits only private, unlinked, hidden-history groups. The count must equal linked members plus 1, so every reader must be linked. HUMAN_CAP is 6. Produces a SHA-256 revision digest. Explicitly not atomic.
assets.taxila_target: group-ai: the 'authorized set must equal the complete current listener set' rule for native in-app sessions
assets.notes: Taxila should not run children on Telegram.

assets.title: Truthful delivery outcomes
assets.what: Preflights the whole render before any send. Requires an own data property ok:true for each fragment or reaction, and stops at the first unconfirmed one. Throws a frozen surface_delivery_unconfirmed {phase, outcome unknown|not_executed, accepted/attempted counts, retrySafe:false} with no raw cause. The assistant log is written only after confirmed delivery.
assets.taxila_target: realtime-voice + telemetry: log 'teacher said X' only after audio playback is confirmed; parent notification marked sent only on a provider receipt; never auto-retry unknown
assets.evidence: surface-delivery 44; baseline probes reproduced the false-success bugs
assets.notes: Adapter acceptance is not human receipt.

assets.title: Provider-envelope budget, refuse before slicing
assets.what: JSON.stringify({compiled:{core,tail},turns}) must be at most 98,304 UTF-8 bytes. Core must be at most 64,000 and tail at most 24,000 string units, which are the adapters' slice points. Refuses before dispatch instead of letting adapters truncate safety text.
assets.taxila_target: prompt-compiler: guarantee the child-safety floor at the end of the prompt is never sliced
assets.evidence: empty-turn envelope 55,541 B; ordinary question 56,452 B; double-count bug at 111,236 B fixed

assets.title: Ordered group turn pipeline (onGroupMessage)
assets.what: Steps in order: freeze ev/ctx/adapter; resolve room; commands first (app-voiced); guard; consent-time fence; deterministic participation decision; STORE episode + human log only if consent, quorum, linked speaker and entitled; log the decision; RETRIEVE facts/bridge/roster/candidates through the predicate; bind the whole candidate pool; select; compile with roomBundle; gated reply with authority checks before and after the model; deliver with a check per fragment; then the assistant log.
assets.taxila_target: group-ai: Taxila group-session turn loop (STORE -> DECIDE -> RETRIEVE -> RENDER)

assets.title: Immutable-audience episode + log writers
assets.what: A single-statement CTE creates the episode and all participants and verifies the count. The log insert re-checks that episode participants equal current linked members, that there is no deny, scope=participants, consent before the source, and no relink at or after the source. Refusal returns null and the caller throws.
assets.taxila_target: db-schema: session_episode + session_participant per turn/segment for multi-child sessions
assets.evidence: SQL50 cases 'one statement creates exact immutable audience', 'late joiner cannot inherit', temporal-writer groups
assets.notes: Neon SQL-over-HTTP needs one statement per request, hence CTEs.

assets.title: Structural disclosure predicate
assets.what: One SQL fragment for fact, phrase and episode. Deny wins (row and cited episodes). Sensitive or negative-affect rows never cross a boundary. Otherwise a row needs a cited grant covering every recipient, OR every recipient participated in every cited episode. An uncited row goes only to its owner's 1:1. Room isolation uses a scalar room id, and there is a DM-to-DM kill switch. Separately, bridgeEligibilityClause implements ruling A.
assets.taxila_target: safety-floor + relational-os: parent/sibling visibility of what a child said; group-session recall
assets.evidence: Gate 0: 0/31,122 violations vs prompt arm 57.1%/98.1%; migration 008 live 2026-08-18
assets.notes: Already noted at main by hp-main-engine (A59); the tip uses it with per-turn episodes.

assets.title: Deterministic participation decision
assets.what: Runs before the model. Structural gates first (consent, entitlement, quorum, linked speaker), then silent/quiet levels. Explicit address means speak, even under quiet. A 10-minute cooldown only raises the bar. A room-word hit buys only a 👀 reaction; otherwise lurk. Name matching works across Devanagari and Latin without \b. Every decision is logged to vy_group_turn.
assets.taxila_target: group-ai: who-is-being-addressed and turn-taking in multi-child voice sessions (invert to teacher-led defaults)

assets.title: Address strip roster (honorific/rank per member)
assets.what: k:v data per member: say:aap|tum|tu, with rank derived from it (aap=elder, tu=younger, tum=peer, no row=unknown), plus quiet and unlinked:nothing-they-say-is-kept. Rows are dropped whole at the 900-char budget, never half-rendered. The cap of 6 members follows from that budget.
assets.taxila_target: persona-engineering: teacher addresses a parent as aap and children as tum/tu in one turn; sibling names and classes
assets.notes: R6 (multi-register in one turn) is a named open gap.

assets.title: ROOM_MODE_NOTE group rule block (shapes, not lines)
assets.what: Group rules appended at the END OF CORE, never in the appended-last pair: per-addressee register; no hints of DM content ('a hint is a disclosure with deniability'); rooms do not touch; no sides; nobody nudged; unlinked people not kept; same AI-honesty. There is also a one-time intro directive written as a shape.
assets.taxila_target: prompt-compiler: group-session note for the teacher persona (modify 'nobody nudged' to gentle invite)

assets.title: App-voiced room card, receipts and command grammar
assets.what: Deterministic Hinglish card posted before the first episode, listing five facts. A distinct withdraw receipt is sent only after commit. Commands: /chup (room), /chup me, /bolo, /bhool (withdraw), /kya and /kaise (re-post card). Command acknowledgements are app text, never model text.

assets.notes: /chup runs before the membership guard; /bhool scope is agent-wide (audit finding).

assets.title: Ruling A/B: departure and shared-forget semantics
assets.what: A: peers of a departed member keep reactive recall, but the AI never proactively raises it. B: shared room memory is fully erased only when all participants ask. Withdrawal deletes the member's own turns, participant rows and grants.
assets.taxila_target: memory-graph: sibling leaves a study group; one sibling asks to forget a shared session

assets.title: State-inert group episodes (stateWriteCount)
assets.what: Group turns write episodes, facts and phrases but never dyadic relationship state (rel_event, pattern, taste, currency). Inertness is asserted by counting rows from outside. The code notes it is fragile: 'inert by three-valued logic'.
assets.taxila_target: relational-os: a group session must not move one child's 1:1 bond/emotional state; learning evidence must be per-speaker attributed

assets.title: Multimodal evidence normalizer (claim-evidence.js, prompt v3)
assets.what: Projects authority-selected evidence into the claim extractor. Text/markdown and pdf/docx get a UTF-16 locator, SHA-256 and page_mapping:unavailable; their time fields must be null. Audio/video becomes a transcript_span with a ms window and limitations (transcription_may_be_incorrect, word_alignment_unavailable, original_source_time_mapping_unavailable, speaker_identity_not_asserted, plus visual_content_not_observed for video). image_region is refused. The input-set hash includes the prompt version and the outbound projection. Private source fingerprints are stripped before the provider. Claim schema stays v2.
assets.taxila_target: multimodal-vision + learning/pedagogy: a child's spoken answer, notebook photo or worksheet becomes typed evidence with honest limits feeding learning-profile and comprehension claims
assets.notes: No image understanding exists. Taxila must add a vision-model interpretation kind with its own limitations.

assets.title: Source-aware claim review (server + client projection)
assets.what: The server re-verifies each citation before emitting it: evidence normalizes, source is in the claim's source_ids, the UTF-16 slice equals the excerpt, and sha256(excerpt) equals quote_hash. Only then does it emit a typed projection (modality, format, interpretation, locator, limitations). The client re-validates exact keys and the limitation sets and drops malformed rows. Claims can be filtered by the selected source item. Previews are blanked without training consent.
assets.taxila_target: learning-profile discovery + parent dashboard: 'why does Taxila think Riya learns best with stories?' with exact cited moments and accept/reject

assets.title: 44px touch targets with a rejecting negative-control test
assets.what: Scoped minimum 44x44 px and an 8 px gap token, with the focus ring extended. A hosted Playwright check at 390 and 1440 measures real DOM rects, gap and overlap, actual Tab focus, and five-point elementFromPoint occlusion with zero mutations. An injected minimum-zero CSS must be detected at 27 px, then restored in finally.

assets.title: Keyless hosted synthetic-PostgreSQL SQL proof
assets.what: GitHub Actions postgres:16.15-bookworm service container. hostedGuard refuses NEON/DATABASE/PG*/AZURE/OPENAI env vars and anything other than GitHub-hosted Linux. Production SQL is inserted byte-for-byte via PREPARE/EXECUTE, so PostgreSQL infers the parameter types; arrays go through array-input text. Canonical DDL is extracted from the migrations. There are 50 groups with rejecting SQL mutations.

The query double asserts the full shipping disclosure predicate text and binds before returning declared rows. Hooks inject mutations during authority, model, send and writes.

assets.title: Held-request barrier for UI race tests
assets.what: expect(kind) resolves only once the fixture server has parsed and held that exact request kind and generation. It supports explicit release; reset() bumps the generation and rejects stale expectations. No fixed sleeps or timeout inflation.

assets.title: Research registry + research-cycle CLI

Each experiment has state (planned/implemented/completed) and outcome (pass/fail/inconclusive, only once completed), plus successCriteria, evidenceScope and result. assets.what: The corpus and method hashes were sent before the method was inspected. 8 families x EN/HI/code-switch x 2 variants, with an adversarial variant 2. The runner re-verifies the hashes on every run. Per-family and per-variant results are reported unpooled. Retention and tombstone tradeoffs are analyzed; queued disclosures must be cancellable.

concepts.name: Common-friend Group AI
concepts.description: One AI persona is a member of a multi-human chat (2-6 linked humans). 'The friend who was in the room with you.' Its value is remembering the room and carrying room context into each member's DM, never carrying DM secrets into rooms.

concepts.name: Two products both called Room
concepts.description: The common-friend group (/api/tg etc. through _surface/_room) vs the creator-private follower Room (/api/room). The latter's tests never authorize the former.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Keep 1:1 tutoring and group sessions as separate authorities.

concepts.name: Structural disclosure
concepts.description: Privacy as a SQL WHERE clause applied before ranking; a row never retrieved cannot leak. Measured 0/31,122 vs prompt arm 57-98%.

concepts.name: Episode-participant ACL
concepts.description: A derived row's audience is everyone who participated in every cited episode. Membership governs the live channel; participation governs history.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Late joiners never see old sessions.

concepts.name: Immutable audience per turn
concepts.description: Each human turn gets a fresh episode whose participants equal the exact current linked set, created in one SQL statement.

concepts.name: Consent as a platform act + app-voiced card
concepts.description: Admin promotion is read consent; a deterministic card states the rules before the first episode. Disclosures are app strings, never model output.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Session-start privacy card; parental consent screen.

concepts.name: No person row, no persistence (adult gate)
concepts.description: Unlinked or unconsented speakers exist only in the live window. Known minors are refused in Vyakti.

concepts.name: Deterministic participation decision
concepts.description: lurk/react/speak decided in code before the model. Explicit address only; silence logged as an event; cooldown only raises the bar.

concepts.name: Per-addressee register (address strip)
concepts.description: Each member's honorific (aap/tum/tu) and derived rank rendered as data; never publicly correct an elder.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher addresses parent vs child correctly.

concepts.name: Ruling A / Ruling B
concepts.description: A: departed members' shared past is answerable but never raised. B: shared memory fully erased only when all ask.

concepts.name: State-inert group channel
concepts.description: Group episodes never move dyadic relationship state.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Group sessions must not move one child's emotional bond without attributed evidence.

concepts.name: Checkpointed guarantee (A/S/A/S)
concepts.description: Repeated authority/source reads with sticky invalidation. Detects observed change; not atomic, not exactly-once.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Re-check before LLM dispatch and TTS.

concepts.name: Complete audience witness
concepts.description: The current platform audience must equal the authorized set; a bounded observation, not a transaction.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Seat roster revision in native sessions.

concepts.name: Known-consent admission fence
concepts.description: Source time must be strictly later than every known consent/link boundary, enforced in JS and in SQL.

concepts.name: Adapter-reported acceptance / truthful delivery
concepts.description: Success only on explicit ok:true. Unknown outcomes are never blindly retried. Logs only after confirmation.

concepts.name: Durable effect states
concepts.description: prepared / executing / confirmed / not_executed / unknown / cancelled; model generation is also an effect.

concepts.name: Attributed source packet
concepts.description: Exact text/spans; recorded speaker separate from the current label; null subject/reply/revision/event time; the packet declares its own limits.

concepts.name: Speaker vs subject
concepts.description: A speaking about B does not make B the speaker; quoting is not authorship.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Credit the right child for an answer.

concepts.name: Whole-payload budgets, refuse not truncate
concepts.description: Measure the full serialized representation; refuse rather than cut required or safety text.

concepts.name: Six-level evidence ledger
concepts.description: Source, offline real caller, actual SQL, hosted release, real transport/provider, consented human task.

concepts.name: Preregistered frozen comparison
concepts.description: Hash the corpus before inspecting the method; report adversarial failures unpooled; any successor needs new held-out cases.

concepts.name: Negative controls everywhere
concepts.description: Every gate proves it can fail: CSS minimum-zero, predicate-removal mutants, Gate 0 clause removal.

concepts.name: CPM co-ownership and the mediator role
concepts.description: Petronio: a confidant becomes a co-owner bound by the discloser's rules. Simmel: be mediator, never tertius gaudens.
concepts.taxila_relevance: A teacher must ask the child before telling the parent (consent moment M4).

concepts.name: Observer-to-subject perspectives
concepts.description: Honcho-style separation of what each observer may know about a subject; explicit vs inferred facts.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher-view vs parent-view of the child.

concepts.name: Modality-honest evidence
concepts.description: Each evidence row states modality, interpretation (owner text vs machine transcription), locator units and limitations; images are not interpreted without a vision step.
concepts.taxila_relevance: A child's voice answers and notebook photos as evidence.
